neighbours.label: the referring word in 'in that case' / 'in which case' / 'dans ce cas' (pointing back to a stated condition)
fire: If the payment fails, in that case we will contact you by email.
The order may be delayed, in which case you will receive a refund.
Sometimes the server is down. In that case, try again later.
Le train peut être annulé. Dans ce cas, vous serez remboursé.
You may not have a receipt, in which case store credit is offered.
The file might be locked. In this case, close other programs first.
The tenant might object, in which case the lease ends in May.
Perhaps no address is given. In that case the default port is used.
quiet: If the payment fails, we will contact you by email that day.
The order may be delayed, which is common during holidays.
Sometimes the server is down. That is annoying for users.
Le train peut être annulé. Ce matin, il est parti à l'heure.
You may not have a receipt, which makes returns difficult.
The file might be locked. This happens when other programs use it.
The tenant might object to the rent increase in May.
Perhaps no address is given, so the program uses the saved port.
